# Threadé

> Threadé (also written Threade) is an app for tailors, fashion designers, ateliers, boutiques and other small shops. It keeps clients, measurements, orders, production, payments, store stock, invoices, expenses and finance in one place, shared with the business's team. It works offline and installs from the browser on Android, iPhone, Windows and Mac.

- Measurements are kept as dated versions; each order keeps the version it was made with.
- Plans: Free (1 person), Pro (3 people) and Business (10 people). Pro and Business prices are to be announced. During the pilot, until 30 November 2026, every business has all of Business free.
- Available to businesses in Nigeria, the United Kingdom, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, Ireland, Canada and the United States, each in its own currency.
- Data is kept on the team's devices and on servers in the European Union (Ireland).
- Provided by Dan Aremu, a sole trader trading as Threadé. Contact: support@threade.app, team@threade.app.
